description: Upload screenshots to a SmartUI project as a new build, from local file_paths or from source_urls (fetched server-side, so it works without a client filesystem). Pass project_id to auto-resolve the project token. Set mark_baseline=true to seed a baseline. Returns build_id; follow with smartui_build_query(action=gate).

file_paths.description: Absolute local image paths (.png/.jpg/.jpeg). Only usable when the MCP server runs locally over stdio — the hosted server cannot see your filesystem; use source_urls there.

mark_baseline.description: Mark this build as the baseline

project_id.description: Project id — preferred; the projectToken is resolved automatically

screenshot_name.description: Name this screenshot (binds it to that baseline) instead of using the file/URL name. Only valid when uploading exactly one image.

source_urls.description: Public http/https image URLs, fetched server-side (max 20). Works in hosted mode.

name: smartui_screenshot_upload
title: SmartUI Screenshot Upload
